generic_domain.justification: The term 'interpretability' refers to how easily a human can understand the mechanisms of an algorithm or AI model. However, adding 'and explainability' expands this domain to cover not just the inherent clarity of the model's operations but also its ability to provide clear explanations for its decisions. This broader scope makes 'interpretability and explainability' a more comprehensive term that encompasses both understanding the inner workings (interpretability) and providing understandable outputs (explainability).
